patch.summary: Bulk update Context Status, Tags and Custom Fields
patch.description:
Updates the status, tags, and custom fields of one or more Contexts.

#### Request fields

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `contextIds`     | IDs of the Contexts to update. |
| `status`     | Status to set on each Context. |
| `tags`     | Tags to apply to each Context. Refer to the Tags section below. |
| `customFields`     | Custom fields to set on each Context. Refer to the Custom fields section below. |

`contextIds` is required. At least one of `status`, `tags`, or `customFields` is also required. Requests that do not meet these conditions fail with an error.

#### Tags

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entries`     | Tags to apply to each Context. Each tag can have up to 255 characters. |
| `updateType`     | Determines how the specified tags are applied. `APPEND` keeps the existing tags and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing tags with the new ones. |

Both `entries` and `updateType` are required for `tags`. Requests that omit either one fail with an error.

#### Custom fields

| Field     | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entries`     | Custom fields to set, as pairs of name and value. Refer to the Custom field rules section below for the format of each value. |
| `updateType`     | Update type for a multi-select custom field. `APPEND` keeps the existing options and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing options with the new ones. |

`updateType` applies to custom fields of the Multi-select type only. It is required when a request updates a Multi-select custom field. It is not allowed when none of the custom fields in the request are of the Multi-select type.

#### Custom field rules

* Custom field names are case-insensitive.
* A custom field that does not exist in the project causes the request to fail with an error.
* A custom field with an empty value is ignored and keeps its current value.

| Field type | Value format |
| --- | --- |
| Text, Text area | Plain text of up to 4096 characters. |
| Date | Date in `MM/dd/yyyy` format, for example `12/31/2026`. |
| Boolean | `True` or `False`. The values `1` and `0` are also accepted. |
| User list | Email address of a user that exists in the project. |
| Single select | An option that exists for the field. |
| Multi-select | Option names separated by commas, for example `chrome,firefox`. To include a comma in an option name, write it as `\\,`. For example, `chrome\\,browser` selects the single option `chrome,browser`. |

status.description: Status to set on each Context.

entries.description: Tags to apply to each Context. Each tag can have up to 255 characters.

updateType.description: Determines how the specified tags are applied. `APPEND` keeps the existing tags and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing tags with the new ones.

entries.description: Custom fields to set, as pairs of name and value.

updateType.description: Update type for a multi-select custom field. `APPEND` keeps the existing options and adds the new ones. `OVERRIDE` replaces all existing options with the new ones. Required when a multi-select custom field is updated, and not allowed otherwise.

200.description: Bulk update completed with detailed results showing successfully updated Contexts and not found Context IDs.

updatedEntities.description: List of IDs that were successfully updated

notFoundEntities.description: List of IDs that were not found

400.description: One or more values in the request are not valid. No Contexts are updated.
